name: Walt Disney World Resort
note: Rating note: the ownership chain is sourced — Walt Disney World Resort is one of The Walt Disney Company's own domestic theme parks (walt-disney-world-owner-record, SEC DEF 14A 2026), and the same proxy names The Vanguard Group (8.5%) and BlackRock, Inc. (6.9%) as the only holders above 5% (the-walt-disney-company-ownership); no state or state fund appears in the chain. Held unrated for a person before any none rating. Two items need a person's call against METHOD.md's company test: (1) the UK House of Commons Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy Committee's 2021 report 'Uyghur forced labour in Xinjiang and UK value chains' states that Disney partnered on the filming of Mulan in Xinjiang, thanked the Turpan security bureau and the CPC Xinjiang publicity department in the film's credits, and that Disney's response to the committee's questions 'failed to address this urgent question' (https://committees.parliament.uk/publications/5095/documents/52855/default); (2) China Labor Watch's June 2016 undercover investigation 'The Dark World of Disney' found workers at two Disney-authorised toy supplier factories in Dongguan forced to work overtime every day and exposed to toxic chemicals without protective equipment (https://chinalaborwatch.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/The-Dark-World-of-Disney.pdf). Neither is a court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO finding against the company itself of the kind METHOD.md requires, but a person should decide before this sponsor goes back to none.
